purpose: A HealthKit audiogram panel with two catalog LOINC components and one text-only component at 125 Hz, a frequency the catalog does not code. The official Validator must accept the control and reject, through healthkit-audiogram-panel-1, a component without a catalog coding at 250 Hz, which the catalog codes, whether it is text-only, written as 250.0 or coded in another code system, and a second component for the same ear and frequency.
